# Agent system (toy)

The toy agent-config document the suites copy into a toy checkout's `docs/AGENT-SYSTEM.md` (tests/sandbox.py
`seed()` puts it there). It stands for the canonical doc `sync_system_doc.py` propagates into each project's
`.claude/AGENT-SYSTEM.md`: any text will do, and nothing here is a real project's.

- Generated files are overwritten on every session start: edit the source, then run the generator.
- One paragraph, so a copy that differs from it is easy to see.
